tool_args.rationale: The paid observations carry the high-frequency sign-oscillation signature. The applicable rule requires abstention rather than fitting a stationary smooth mechanism or purchasing another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid pilot already reports high-frequency sign oscillation, which requires scoped abstention under the decision rules.

considered_alternatives.option: Avrami, Vogel–Fulcher–Tammann, and Fowler–Nordheim stationary models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed sign-changing pilot and oscillation signature do not establish any of these recalled mechanisms as a reliable forecast law.
The auxiliary probe is irrelevant to identifying the forecast law.
